title: Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025
population: Organisations researched by the Ponemon Institute; global, predominantly larger organisations
measure: Average total cost of a data breach

distributionAssumption.note: The source reports a mean but not a median or variance. Sigma is an explicit weak prior used to construct a sensitivity distribution, not an observed source parameter.

permittedUses: tail-severity sensitivity against DSIT reference classes
prohibitedUses: applying the average to every organisation
pooling the average directly with DSIT respondent-level quantiles as though populations were identical
treating average breach cost as annual expected loss or annual total loss
limitations: The sample is not representative of all UK businesses.
Sample selection favours organisations able to measure large breach costs.
Only the average is used; no median or quantile is claimed from the source.
The distribution shape and sigma are assumptions and must remain sensitivity-labelled.
The 2025 edition is used alone; headline values from different editions are not treated as independent observations.
